verdict.rationale: The evidence documents some fraud-adjacent prevention tooling, such as KYC/KYB identity and watchlist checks, external-account balance checks before ACH debits, and enhanced due diligence. Nothing in the pack says who bears losses from ACH return fraud, card disputes, or account takeover, or how liability is split between the fintech, Synctera, and the partner bank. Prevention features alone do not make the fraud economics explicit, so the core of the story is unevidenced.
